title: Shugaban Al'umma da aka Naɗa
intro: A lokacin da mutane ke fuskantar ƙalubale da yanke ƙauna, an yi alƙawarin Allah. Wannan mutumin, wanda da farko mutane da yawa suka yi watsi da shi, Allah ya zaɓe shi don ya jagoranci al'umma a kan wani abokin gaba mai ƙarfi. Labarinsu shaida ne ga ƙarfin imani da hikimar da ke cikin hukuncin Allah, wanda ke nuna cewa ba koyaushe ake samun shugabanci na gaskiya a wurare da ake tsammani ba.
clues: Allah ya zaɓe ni in zama shugaba ga mutanena lokacin da suka nemi mai mulki don ya yi yaƙi a tafarkinSa.
Mutanena sun fara tambayar naɗina, suna jin cewa wasu sun fi cancanta saboda dukiyarsu ko zuriyarsu.
Alamar shugabancina na gaskiya ita ce dawowar wani akwati mai tsarki, wanda ke ɗauke da kayan tarihi daga annabawan da suka gabata, wanda ya kawo natsuwa.
Na jagoranci rundunar sojojina zuwa wani kogi, inda na gwada biyayyarsu ta hanyar hana su shan fiye da cokali ɗaya na ruwa.
Duk da ƙarancin adadin waɗanda suka dage bayan gwajin, mun fuskanci wani babban jarumi da rundunarsu.
A ƙarƙashin jagorancina, wani matashi daga cikin sojojina, wanda ba sanannen mayaƙi ba ne, ya fuskanci babban zakaran maƙiyi kuma ya kayar da shi.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Naɗin a matsayin shugaba a kan wani ƙaton mutum
trial.answer: Naɗin a matsayin shugaba a kan wani ƙaton mutum

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An kafa mulki mai tarin dukiya da iko.
An nutsar da mutanen cikin ambaliyar ruwa mai tsanani.
An kayar da zakaran maƙiyi, kuma Allah ya ba shi nasara.
Fari mai tsanani ya addabi ƙasar tsawon shekaru.
Wani babban halitta ya haɗiye shugaban.
outcome.answer: An kayar da zakaran maƙiyi, kuma Allah ya ba shi nasara.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
